title.value: Draft a film script outline, biography book and business card

introduction.value: A TechRadar writer compared Manus with ChatGPT on script research, a 10,000-word Adobe biography and a business card design.

method.value: Eric Hal Schwartz ran the same prompts through Manus and ChatGPT. For the fantasy screenplay, Manus researched Mayan and Egyptian civilizations, brainstormed ideas, picked one and outlined a film. He also asked each tool for a roughly 10,000-word novel-style Adobe biography. For the business card, he attached his resume and asked for an Apple-inspired design. Manus's demo prompts were reused for ChatGPT.

outcome.value: Manus was more thorough on the script, followed the Adobe length better and made a usable business card. ChatGPT's script matched it on creativity, but its Adobe biography read like a Wikipedia article and its card was messy.

notes.value: Manus was invite-only at the time, and the author notes its demos are likely best-case examples. He did not test ChatGPT's Deep Research.

source_text.body:
Draft a film script outline, biography book and business card
A TechRadar writer compared Manus with ChatGPT on script research, a 10,000-word Adobe biography and a business card design.
Done with
MA
Manus
What they did
Eric Hal Schwartz ran the same prompts through Manus and ChatGPT. For the fantasy screenplay, Manus researched Mayan and Egyptian civilizations, brainstormed ideas, picked one and outlined a film. He also asked each tool for a roughly 10,000-word novel-style Adobe biography. For the business card, he attached his resume and asked for an Apple-inspired design. Manus's demo prompts were reused for ChatGPT.
How it went
Manus was more thorough on the script, followed the Adobe length better and made a usable business card. ChatGPT's script matched it on creativity, but its Adobe biography read like a Wikipedia article and its card was messy.
Worth knowing
Manus was invite-only at the time, and the author notes its demos are likely best-case examples. He did not test ChatGPT's Deep Research.
Try it yourself
with
Manus
Copy prompt
Research [subject] and produce [a film script outline, a roughly [number]-word biography of a person or company, or a business card design for [my name and role]]. Cite sources for factual claims and keep the tone [tone]. Deliver one finished document or design file, and tell me what you were unsure about.
Original source: https://www.techradar.com/computing/artificial-intelligence/i-compared-manus-ai-to-chatgpt-now-i-understand-why-everyone-is-calling-it-the-next-deepseek
